faq.q: What room categories does Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica offer?
faq.a: The resort offers Jr. Suites, connecting Jr. Suites with two rooms, and garden-view Jr. Suites, many designed with sea views, plus fully accessible options.

faq.q: Is the resort all-inclusive and what's included?
faq.a: Yes, it's a 24-hour all-inclusive resort with 5 restaurants, 7 bars, six pools, a swim-up bar, spa, gym, and the Splash Water World water park.

faq.q: Where is Hotel Riu Palace Costa Rica located?
faq.a: It sits directly on Playa Matapalo near Sardinal in Guanacaste, roughly under an hour from Guanacaste Airport (LIR) in Liberia.

faq.q: Can I book private tours from Riu Palace Costa Rica?
faq.a: Yes. Wild Papagayo offers private tours with direct hotel pickup from Riu Palace Costa Rica, including waterfalls, wildlife, volcanoes and adventure day trips throughout Guanacaste.

faq.q: Does Wild Papagayo pick up directly from Riu Palace?
faq.a: Yes. Private pickup is arranged directly from the resort, so there is no separate meeting point to reach on your own.

faq.q: How far is Riu Palace Costa Rica from Liberia Airport?
faq.a: Approximately 41 to 53 minutes by private transfer from Guanacaste Airport (LIR), about 33 km away.

faq.q: What are the best day trips from Riu Palace Costa Rica?
faq.a: Popular options include the Buena Vista Mega Combo, Miravalles Volcano, and sloth and wildlife experiences, along with private day trips to Río Celeste and other Guanacaste destinations.
